patterns.statement: A roguelike room must have a watchdog timeout and progress monitor to prevent soft-lock from unreachable or failed-spawn NPCs.
patterns.condition: A room with active NPCs has doors locked but kill target unreachable: spawned NPCs are stuck, unreachable, or spawn failed.
patterns.action: Implement room watchdog: absolute timeout on empty room plus progress monitor that recalculates kill target from spawned NPCs if kills stall for N seconds; auto-unlock exit if still stuck.

patterns.statement: A roguelike multiplayer must filter player deaths from NPC kills in shared elimination handlers to prevent false completion and reward bugs.
patterns.condition: Elimination event handler shared between players and NPCs without type filtering, causing player deaths to increment room kill count.
patterns.action: At handler entry, filter by actor type using player[agent] check; separate player-death logic from NPC-death logic before counting kills or assigning rewards.

patterns.statement: A roguelike global reset must check per-room occupancy to avoid trapping late-joiners.
patterns.condition: Global reset at run end resets all rooms indiscriminately, trapping late-joiners in soft-locked empty rooms.
patterns.action: Check room occupancy per room before reset; only reset empty rooms; preserve player state if connected.

patterns.statement: Use phase enum instead of multiple state booleans in roguelike level handlers.
patterns.condition: Level handler uses multiple boolean flags for phase tracking, causing incoherent state combinations and race bugs.
patterns.action: Replace booleans with single phase enum (Idle, Active, Clearing, Completed, WaitingForExit) to enforce valid state-only transitions.

patterns.statement: Never cancel the current enclosing task; spawn separate and defer cleanup.
patterns.condition: Completion handler is called inside a task loop and cancels that same task before returning, risking incomplete execution.
patterns.action: Spawn completion as separate task from loop, exit loop after spawn, release cleanup flags via defer.

patterns.statement: Never allow UI code to modify game state flags; only log and retry.
patterns.condition: UI initialization code modifies game state flags directly when UI unavailable, blocking progression.
patterns.action: UI code only logs and retries; game state is exclusively modified by game-logic handlers, never UI.

patterns.statement: Hard mode must be reset at run end or tracked per-player, not left global and permanent.
patterns.condition: Hard mode flag is set true at trigger and never reset to false, making it permanent for all players until server restart.
patterns.action: Reset hard mode flag in global reset/run end, or make it per-player instead of global.

patterns.statement: Never clear ActivePlayers in global reset; preserve connected player state.
patterns.condition: Global reset at run end clears ActivePlayers list with players still connected, leaving timer and progress tracking frozen.
patterns.action: Never clear ActivePlayers; repopulate from GetPlayspace().GetPlayers() if needed to preserve connected player state.

patterns.statement: Clean up all per-player map state on player disconnect.
patterns.condition: Per-player state maps lack cleanup on player disconnect, accumulating stale state across sessions.
patterns.action: All devices with [agent]map state subscribe to PlayerRemovedEvent and remove player entries.

patterns.statement: Clean NPC registries when despawning NPCs that do not trigger elimination events.
patterns.condition: NPC despawn events fail to clean registries (NpcToLevel, BossRegistry), accumulating stale entries and O(n) rebuilds per kill.
patterns.action: When NPCs despawn without triggering elimination event, remove entries from registries to prevent memory leak and performance degradation.

patterns.statement: Initialize claimed flag in all room entry points to prevent double-claiming.
patterns.condition: Reward claimed flag (HasClaimedReward) only set in one return path, allowing second claim after respawn within same room.
patterns.action: Set HasClaimedReward in all entry points (StartSequence, re-entry); assign reward to actual killer, not first cache entry.

patterns.statement: Always Sleep in spawn/iteration loops to prevent server hang.
patterns.condition: Spawn loops without Sleep on failure path can tight-loop and block server.
patterns.action: Always Sleep in any loop that spawns actors; place Sleep in fallback branch or end of iteration.

patterns.statement: Never await UI response without timeout or generation ID to prevent orphaned tasks.
patterns.condition: Awaiting async UI actions without timeout leaves orphaned tasks if widget destroyed or reset mid-wait.
patterns.action: Use race between timeout and UI signal, or attach generation ID to invalidate old awaits on reset.

patterns.statement: Use generation ID to prevent duplicate passive-income loop spawns.
patterns.condition: Persistent passive-income loops (AFK) can spawn duplicate instances if player exits and re-enters zone <1s, doubling income.
patterns.action: Use generation counter or task handle per player to invalidate old spawned loops on re-entry.

patterns.statement: Guard exponential currency math against NaN/Inf overflow.
patterns.condition: Exponential calculations on unbounded currency sums can overflow to NaN/Inf, causing infinite loops in normalization.
patterns.action: Guard loop conditions and calculation inputs: IsFinite check before processing, range clamp on exponents.

patterns.statement: Recompute leaderboard sort and display only on real record changes, using cached top-N slots.
patterns.condition: A leaderboard re-sorts and rewrites billboards every tick or for all players, causing hitches as player count and history grow.
patterns.action: Cache the sorted top-N and formatted slots; recompute only when a record actually changed, and prune entries of players who are no longer relevant.

patterns.statement: Retry only the spawners that produced no NPC, tracked via per-spawner probes.
patterns.condition: A room spawns NPCs from several spawners and some spawners silently produce none, leaving the room short of its kill target.
patterns.action: Count spawned NPCs per spawner with a probe and, after N seconds, retry only the spawners that produced nothing instead of re-running the whole spawn sequence.

patterns.statement: A roguelike run needs one single owner of the end-of-run transition, guarded by a global run phase.
patterns.condition: End-of-run can be triggered from several paths, each resetting the run, causing double resets and duplicate rewards.
patterns.action: Keep one global run_phase enum and make a single function the only owner of the end-of-run transition; other paths request it and no-op if the phase already advanced.

patterns.statement: Placed devices without a per-agent API are global: guard them with a lock or assign one per player.
patterns.condition: Placed devices like modifiers or trackers are map-global, so per-player effects applied through them bleed across players.
patterns.action: Serialize use of the shared device with a lock, or use one device or tracker per player; treat any API without an agent parameter as global state.

patterns.statement: Set per-player re-entrancy locks synchronously before the first suspend and release them on all exits.
patterns.condition: A button or trigger fires twice quickly, so a suspending handler (UI open, purchase, claim) runs twice and double-grants.
patterns.action: Check-and-set a per-player in-memory lock synchronously at handler entry, before any suspending call, and release it on every exit path.

patterns.statement: Persistence reads need a fallback for an unpopulated cache, a zero clamp, and a still-connected check after the await.
patterns.condition: Persistent data is read via an in-memory cache not yet populated at join, so reads return empty or stale values and balances go negative.
patterns.action: Fall back to the persisted value, default to an empty map if the entry is missing, clamp at zero, and re-check the player is still connected after any async read.

patterns.statement: Pooled drops need per-slot occupancy tracking and per-item listeners that know their index.
patterns.condition: A pooled drop picks the next slot cyclically without checking if it is still in flight, so a new drop overwrites an uncollected one.
patterns.action: Track per-slot occupancy, free the slot synchronously on collect, and pick the first free slot from the cursor; use a per-item listener that knows its own index.

patterns.statement: Rate-limit repeated failed attempts per player on code-entry devices, and clean the counters on disconnect.
patterns.condition: A code-entry or purchase device lets a player brute-force or spam attempts with no limit.
patterns.action: Count consecutive failures per player; after the max, block verification for a cooldown; clear the counter on success and on player leave.

patterns.statement: Keep per-player run state in one session object per player, not in many parallel maps.
patterns.condition: Per-player run state is spread across many independent [agent]X maps that drift out of sync on join, leave and reset.
patterns.action: Group per-player state in one session class stored in a single [agent]session map; create it on join, delete it on leave, reset it as a unit.

patterns.statement: Version the persistent player data container and repair corrupt saved values on load.
patterns.condition: Persistent player data schema must change after release, or earlier bugs left corrupt values (e.g. negative balances) in saved data.
patterns.action: Wrap persisted fields in a versioned data class inside a global archive, and run a migration on load that repairs invalid values (clamp at zero) before use.

patterns.statement: Identify configurable items by an explicit enum role, not by array position.
patterns.condition: Editor-configured item arrays are read by position, so reordering them in the editor silently breaks logic.
patterns.action: Give each item an explicit enum role field and look items up by role, never by array index.

patterns.statement: Use one persistent per-player UI task with a race-based debounce to aggregate rapid pickup popups.
patterns.condition: A broadcast event feeds one long-lived task per player; a popup must aggregate rapid repeated events.
patterns.action: Keep one persistent task per player owning its widget; race a 2s Sleep against the next event to debounce and extend one animation.

patterns.statement: Gate currency actions on a per-player data-ready flag, and update the cache only from the confirmed persistence write result.
patterns.condition: Currency cache mirrors saved data; an earn/spend action arrives before load finishes or the save write fails.
patterns.action: Gate actions on a per-player data-ready flag; check balance before spending; write to persistence first, update cache only with the returned value.

patterns.statement: Feed player death from two sources into one handler with a per-agent dedupe window, so environmental deaths still end the run.
patterns.condition: Environmental deaths (storm, fall, damage volume) emit no elimination-manager event, so run reset never fires.
patterns.action: Add a per-character elimination fallback feeding one shared death handler, deduped per agent within a few seconds across sources.

patterns.statement: Log a startup release-checklist warning for each dev flag left enabled.
patterns.condition: Debug/test flags (zero enemies, fast mode, verbose logs) stay enabled by mistake at release.
patterns.action: Log a one-line release warning at startup for every dev flag still enabled, so playtest logs expose it.

patterns.statement: Gate each gameplay fix behind an editable rollback flag so it can be reverted without recompiling.
patterns.condition: Fixes to a stable gameplay loop risk regressions after playtests.
patterns.action: Ship each behavior change behind an @editable flag defaulting to the new behavior, where false restores the old path without recompiling.

patterns.statement: Give end-of-run a single owner with a run-phase enum and a stale-limit dedupe.
patterns.condition: End-of-run sequencing was split across several timers, causing double victory and stale HUD.
patterns.action: Use one run-phase enum (Lobby/Run/Victory/Reset) with a single owner of end-of-run, deduping a second victory unless the first is older than a stale limit.

patterns.statement: Consolidate per-player state into a single session class with a get-or-create accessor.
patterns.condition: Per-player state lives in many parallel [agent]X maps that drift out of sync.
patterns.action: Consolidate into one per-agent session class created on demand by a getter, migrating fields incrementally.

patterns.statement: Make end-of-run reset occupant-aware and generation-guarded so late-joiners are never reset.
patterns.condition: Several players share rooms; a global end-of-run reset runs while a late-joiner already started a new run.
patterns.action: Skip rooms with live non-winner occupants and keep their sessions; reset only empty rooms, and cancel stale scheduled resets by comparing a run-end generation.

patterns.statement: Drive doors from one phase-derived function that resends the full command group, since physical devices can lose commands.
patterns.condition: Doors are driven from several code paths and replication can drop a single open/close command.
patterns.action: Route every door command through one phase-driven function that resends the full command group each call; never skip by cached state.

patterns.statement: Keep presence caches event-driven and run native volume queries only as a throttled safety net.
patterns.condition: A per-room monitor loop calls an expensive native volume query (GetAgentsInVolume) every second during combat.
patterns.action: Keep the player cache event-driven from enter/exit events and run the native volume query only as a periodic safety net every N iterations.

patterns.statement: Capture a session id at task start and recheck it after each Sleep so stale room tasks exit on reset.
patterns.condition: A long-running room task keeps running after the room was reset and restarted.
patterns.action: Capture a room session id at task start and compare it after every Sleep; exit if it changed; increment the id on every reset or restart.

patterns.statement: Judge room presence by session and proximity radius, not only a narrow zone volume, to avoid false abandonment resets.
patterns.condition: A narrow zone volume marks fighting players as 'left the room', triggering false abandonment resets mid-combat.
patterns.action: Count a player present by session plus proximity radius, not volume only; give a grace window to a player who triggered the room from outside the zone.

patterns.statement: On shared doors between adjacent rooms, let open requests win over close requests.
patterns.condition: Two adjacent rooms share one physical door (exit of N is entrance of N+1) and close requests conflict.
patterns.action: Before closing, check whether the neighbor room wants the shared door open (same position) and skip the close; open wins.

patterns.statement: Yield briefly between spawner Reset/Enable and Spawn, since Spawn can fail silently.
patterns.condition: NPC spawner Spawn() is called right after Reset()/Enable() and silently produces no NPC.
patterns.action: Yield briefly (Sleep ~0.05s) between Reset/Enable and Spawn, and track per-spawner spawned counts to retry only the silent ones.

patterns.statement: Use a per-slot busy pool with drop generations for shared collectibles, freeing slots on pickup and timeout.
patterns.condition: A shared pool of drop collectibles is reused by every kill; fast kills re-teleport a coin still live or uncollected.
patterns.action: Track per-slot busy flags, pick the first free slot per drop, free it on collection and on timeout, and version each drop with a generation so a stale despawn timer cannot hide a reused coin.

patterns.statement: Queue room rewards per player and open the choice menu on a player claim input, never forced.
patterns.condition: Room-clear rewards pile up, and a forced menu mid-combat steals input or interrupts the player.
patterns.action: Queue reward packs per player, show only a small counter popup, and open the choice menu when the player presses a claim input.

patterns.statement: Never store per-player unlocks on shared config objects; derive them per player from persistent data.
patterns.condition: Unlock state is stored on a shared config object that runtime code flips, so one player's unlock changes another's reward pool.
patterns.action: Keep config flags editor-only (e.g. free starter) and compute unlocks per player live from persistent tier data.

patterns.statement: Use an escalating reroll cost that resets after each choice as a currency sink.
patterns.condition: Players can reroll reward choices and the loop needs a repeatable currency sink.
patterns.action: Charge a reroll cost that rises per reroll in the same menu and resets to base once a choice is made.

patterns.statement: Set a per-player menu-open flag synchronously before spawning the menu task, and release it on every exit path.
patterns.condition: A double interaction opens two concurrent menu tasks for one player, each awaiting its own widget.
patterns.action: Set a per-player menu-open flag synchronously before spawning the task and clear it on every exit path.

patterns.statement: Use a per-device listener object holding its index when events carry only the agent.
patterns.condition: N identical buttons/devices fire events that carry only the agent, not which device fired.
patterns.action: Create one small listener object per device storing its index and owner, and subscribe its handler instead of N copied functions.

patterns.statement: Use one tracker per station with static text, since tracker text setters are global and not per player.
patterns.condition: Many station devices share one tracker whose title/description setters take no agent, so players see each other's text.
patterns.action: Give each station its own tracker with static text set once at start; only assign/complete per agent.

patterns.statement: Guard one-time rewards with a synchronous in-memory lock as well as the persistent flag.
patterns.condition: A one-time reward is guarded only by a persistent flag, but the cloud write is not instant, so two rapid events pay twice.
patterns.action: Add a synchronous in-memory per-player lock checked and set before any suspension, alongside the persistent flag.

patterns.statement: Serialize per-player use of a shared powerup device with a busy lock.
patterns.condition: Several players change one shared powerup/amplifier device at the same moment, so SetMagnitude and Pickup interleave.
patterns.action: Serialize access with a busy flag that waiters poll with a short Sleep, set before use and always released after.

patterns.statement: Reapply permanent perks from a per-player watcher after each respawn.
patterns.condition: Permanent stat perks are lost on every respawn because the character object is new.
patterns.action: Run one watcher per player that waits for an active character, reapplies perks after a short delay, then races the death event.

patterns.statement: Persist one cumulative point total and derive level and progress from it.
patterns.condition: Level and progress are stored separately from the points that produce them and drift out of sync.
patterns.action: Persist only a monotonic total of points and derive level, progress and next threshold on demand from it.

patterns.statement: Merge partial saves onto a base read from cache or cloud, never an empty map.
patterns.condition: A partial save merges new entries into a cache that is not yet populated, overwriting real saved data.
patterns.action: Build the merge base from the cache, falling back to a direct cloud read, then write the full merged map.

patterns.statement: Resubscribe per-character events on every respawn from a single generation-guarded watcher.
patterns.condition: Per-character events (damage, elimination) stop firing after the first death because respawn creates a new character.
patterns.action: Run a per-player watcher that resubscribes each time a new active character appears, guarded by a generation id so only one watcher runs.

patterns.statement: Identify configured entries by an explicit role enum, not array position.
patterns.condition: Config entries meaning is tied to their position in an editor array, and reordering breaks them.
patterns.action: Give each entry an explicit role enum and look it up by role.

patterns.statement: Check the persistence size limit before each save and reject negative-balance writes.
patterns.condition: A player save grows with perks and currencies and may exceed the persistence size limit.
patterns.action: Wrap every save in a size-fit check, and make balance updates return an option so a spend that would go negative is rejected.

patterns.statement: Store saved choice indexes offset by one so zero means unset.
patterns.condition: A saved choice index is stored in an integer map where 0 also means no data.
patterns.action: Store the index plus one so zero stays reserved for unset, and fall back to a default entry when unset.

patterns.statement: Cache config lookups used by UI refresh in a map built once at start.
patterns.condition: UI refreshes rescan a config array for the same lookup (currency icons) on every refresh.
patterns.action: Build a lookup map once at start and use O(1) lookups in refreshes.

patterns.statement: Guard per-player init reachable from several paths with an initialized flag cleared on leave.
patterns.condition: A per-player initializer can be reached from two entry points with different delays, double-registering audio or devices.
patterns.action: Gate it with a per-player initialized flag set before the first suspension, and clear the flag on leave.

patterns.statement: Pulse widget animation flags 0 then 1 after a short yield so repeated alerts replay.
patterns.condition: A widget animation driven by an integer flag does not replay when the flag is set to 1 again.
patterns.action: Set the flag to 0, yield a tiny Sleep, set it to 1, then back to 0 after the animation duration.

patterns.statement: Persist a daily-reward streak as last-claim epoch plus day index and reset after two missed days.
patterns.condition: A daily-reward streak must survive sessions and reset fairly when the player skips days.
patterns.action: Persist the last claim epoch and the next day index; validate before every refresh/claim and reset the streak after two full days without a claim.

patterns.statement: Respawn harvestable props by moving them away and back instead of spawning or disposing them.
patterns.condition: Harvestable props must respawn many times without creating or destroying props at runtime.
patterns.action: Move a hit-depleted prop below the map, wait the respawn time, move it back to its initial transform and restore health.
